policy: Release certification is earned from ordered evidence. Static source signals and legacy scores never certify a game.

scenarios: Start from the Korean route and steer left and right while auto-fire advances score and wave feedback.
Survive through three hits and confirm the debrief names the last damage cause, kill count, score, and personal best.
Retry the same sector, observe the PB ghost cue, pause and continue immediately, then mute audio.
findings: No horizontal overflow at 390px; the canvas, HUD, controls, and debrief remain inside the viewport.
Production preview held 60 FPS during the sampled run and emitted no console warnings or errors.
The first run ended quickly without active steering, but the explicit missed-enemy cause and same-sector retry make the failure actionable.

craftReview.note: The mobile loop communicates movement, auto-fire, damage cause, PB ghost, and same-seed retry clearly; weapon upgrades and deterministic replay add depth beyond a disposable shooter skin.

commands: npm run test -- --run src/lib/games/dot-runner.test.ts src/lib/games/dot-runner-replay.test.ts src/lib/games/dot-runner-save.test.ts

scenarios: Reset the Korean route and use repeated canvas taps to jump until the first run ends with a personal best and a concrete next-score target.
Retry the same course and confirm the PB ghost cue appears while score, pace, and controls remain readable during play.
Pause mid-run, mute audio, reload the page, and confirm the paused run score and personal best restore without horizontal overflow.
findings: The first sampled run reached score 54 in five seconds, then presented the personal best, survival time, pace, next target, same-course retry, and new-course choice together.
Same-course retry exposed the PB ghost cue immediately; pausing at score 21 and reloading restored the paused state, score 21, and best score 54.
The 390px production preview reported innerWidth 390 and scrollWidth 375 with no console warnings or errors.

craftReview.note: The one-tap runner makes failure actionable through a next-score target, same-seed retry, deterministic PB ghost, rising pace, and resumable local state while keeping the mobile interaction immediately legible.
